role: Development pilot of the frozen existing M1 complete decision loop; not final OR confirmation or a new algorithm claim.
method_variant: Existing V6 M1 with the algebraically equivalent local KG speedup; no A37/A42/A43 prior and no mixture-aware fantasy replacement.
primary_endpoint: Expected independently verified deployment reward, paired M1 minus fixed_source, reported separately in all five regimes.
secondary_endpoints: Final minus initial-posterior expected reward under the same928-replicate hypothetical verification law
Selected-candidate predicted versus true verifier power
True feasibility and mathematical feasible regret
Target/source calls and measured local CPU time
initial_control: Save the common8-observation recommendation. Its expected reward is postdecision analytic scoring under the same verifier law, not an extra observed certificate. No new validation is supplied to the initial-only control.
pairing: All three arms share candidate bank, initial8, objective law, constraint offsets, observation noise streams and independent verifier seed. Source-informed arms fit the same supplied archive; target_only receives no source labels.
source_accounting: 6144 source calls per supplied archive, disclosed separately. No claim of source acquisition savings or observed amortization. Reuse archives only across matching arms/targets under the existing generator.
training_evaluation_separation: A1-A45 used seeds48-63 for development. Pilot seeds64-71 are reserved for this mechanism line. They become development data once inspected; no later variant may call them untouched confirmation.
analysis: Eight paired seed blocks per regime; mean differences and nominal paired seed bootstrap95 intervals. Do not pool160-style cells as independent tasks, select a winning regime/allocation, or require every adverse regime to win. No comparison endpoint changes after outcomes.

runtime.execution_scope: Run the first complete matched pair locally to measure whole-method cost and preserve results. The full120-cell pilot is prepared but not launched by the preflight. Compare the measured cost to the declared6000CPU-second envelope before arranging the remaining cells; no replacement of the candidate bank, query actions, quadrature or model. No scheduler use or automatic restart.

final_confirmation: After pilot interpretation and mature-baseline/application integration, freeze final method and a separate source/task cohort. This pilot is not sufficient to claim OR readiness.
limitations: Public eight-dimensional finite dictionary and simulator-generated response law. No unified orthogonal function decomposition, learned trajectory encoder, factor HVD or universal high-dimensional guarantee. Current KG uses documented Gaussian fantasies. Independent verification protects certification but does not guarantee profitable recommendation.
next_work: Integrate a faithful mature functional-prior comparator and an Inventory/Queue state-cumulative-risk interface before scheduling further old-generator cells. Keep the frozen pair and planned120-cell specification; do not interpret the preflight as final confirmation.
